item.title: Context Window LLM Comparison 2025: Navigating the Expanding Frontier of AI Memory
item.description: The race for ever-larger LLM context windows is reshaping AI agent capabilities, moving beyond simple retrieval to true contextual understanding. As we enter 2025, the definition of “long-term” memory for AI is being redefined by models capable of processing hundreds of thousands, even millions, of tokens. This article provides a crucial context window LLM comparison 2025, examining how these advancements impact AI performance and offering a detailed AI context window comparison.
